scientific_question: Does the v171 reported-geometry selector remain safe when the complete reported calibration, the complete reconstructed-field model, and the evaluated time are all absent from selector fitting?
role: post-open triple-axis isolation diagnostic; not fresh external evidence, not a field reconstructor, not a resource result, and not real BOST
physical_hypothesis: If the v171 Gram feature captures camera geometry rather than the nine opened reconstructed fields or four opened times, the same small ranker should select safe five-camera subsets when one calibration, one entire field model, and one time slice are jointly held out.

inputs.scope_boundary: v170 opened all finite candidate outcomes; v172 adds computation isolation and cannot be called fresh or external

outer_split.scheme: Cartesian leave-one-complete-calibration-out x leave-one-complete-field-model-out x leave-one-time-out
outer_split.heldout_rule: no candidate metric from the heldout calibration, heldout field model, or heldout time enters the fit target, feature normalization, ridge solve, static control, tie break, or fallback
outer_split.prediction_input: reported geometry only; model identity, time, observation, density, and heldout outcomes are forbidden

strict_fit_target.definition: for each fit calibration and candidate, log of the maximum normalized metric over the eight fit field models, three fit times, and three frozen metrics

geometry_feature.source: inherit the independently validated v171 356-dimensional H1-whitened world-DCT Gram feature

primary_selector.name: Triple-Isolated LOCO-LOMO-LOTO Gram-Ridge Risk Ranker
primary_selector.model: one shared linear ridge regressor with an unpenalized intercept per outer triple
primary_selector.feature_standardization: fit calibrations only; population standard deviation and 1e-12 active-column floor
primary_selector.selection: minimum predicted log risk among 126 candidates; exact ties choose the lowest lexicographic subset index

cheap_controls.fit_static_subset: within each triple fold, choose one subset minimizing worst then mean fit risk over the twelve fit calibrations
cheap_controls.v169_fixed_geometry: the frozen result-blind low-frequency geometry selector repeated for every heldout field and time
cheap_controls.control_rule: either control passing the identical 468-cell, whole-field, whole-calibration, and four-time gate blocks a learned-selector advantage claim

stages: generate and seal all primary and control selections
open parent outcomes and score the heldout cells

cost_accounting.resource_claim: forbidden; no fresh-process wall or whole-pipeline RSS gate

independent_recomputation.features: use the v171 independently reconstructed geometry features rather than the formal feature array
independent_recomputation.targets: rebuild all 468 fit targets from the independently reconstructed v170 candidate metrics
independent_recomputation.ridge_solver: batched augmented least-squares rather than formal normal equations
required_checks: 468 fold packages exclude all three heldout axes

decision_order: Any parent, fold-isolation, prediction-seal, mutation, numeric, scoring, accounting, or independent-recomputation failure makes v172 inconclusive.

If the primary misses any strict heldout cell, whole calibration, whole field model, or time stratum, conclude FAIL_WHOLE_FIELD_TIME_ISOLATED_GEOMETRY_SELECTOR_V172 and close this Gram-ridge selector.
If the primary passes but either cheap control also passes, conclude FAIL_CHEAP_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_FIELD_TIME_ISOLATED_SELECTOR_V172 and do not claim learned-selector advantage.
Only if the primary passes every gate, both controls fail, and independent recomputation agrees may v172 conclude PASS_WHOLE_FIELD_TIME_ISOLATED_GEOMETRY_SELECTOR_HEADROOM_V172.

A pass authorizes only a separately frozen integration with an observation-only warm initializer, exact lift, and unchanged CGLS; it is not fresh external generalization, resource speedup, algorithm breakthrough, or real BOST.
